page.layout: One page of text in a single column of verb glosses, with no marginal notes. Left margin empty. Running head and page number at the top.

main_text.l: Ulciscor, ich rache[?] oder wircke mich an einem / ul-
Expergiscor, ich erwach se/ ich wache auff/ exper-
Paciscor, ich werde eins mit einem / ich mache ein
Orior, oreris vel orere,oritur, ich entstehe/gehe
auff. Infinitum: Oriri. Supinum: Ortum, ortu.
Nitor, ich strebe / verstehe / ich erhalte mich/ich
verlasse mich auff einen/ nixum,nixu & nisum,nisu.
Largior, ich schencke / gebe reichlich auß/ largiris
Largiar, largiaris vel largiare, largiatur, largia-
At Experior, experiris, ich erfahre / expertum, ex-
Adorior, adoriris, ich falle an / ich greiffe an / ador-
Ordior, ordiris, ich hebe an/ fahe an/orsum,orsu,

page.notes: Uncertain readings are marked [?]: the German gloss "zörne" (the umlaut and colon are blurred), "rache" in the line for Ulciscor, "fähle" in the line for Labor, and the "Nanciscor" supine, read as "nactū". The line-final word "Opperior," is cut off at the page edge, and the entry continues on the next page. The German glosses are set in a black-letter-style face and are marked <bl>. Printing errors such as "Paciscor" printed as "Pacifcor" are left in their long-s form, transcribed as plain s.
